name: Octavia E. Butler Landing Site
goal: Landing hub / base for the Marswalk
description: Octavia E. Butler landing site, 18 Feb 2021; elevation -2,570 m (published); about 1.9 km east of the delta remnants; landing ellipse 7.7 x 6.6 km; MOXIE oxygen-production site.
geology: Máaz paver field, crater floor (Z6 landing hub)
science_purpose: Base camp and MOXIE oxygen-production site; start of the Marswalk
chemistry: Máaz: MgO 2.7 wt%, plagioclase 37.9 wt% (CIPW norm) [V2]; MOXIE produced 122 g O2 in 16 runs at 98% purity [V6]

name: Mandu Wall
description: Mandu Wall, inner rim edge of the Margin Unit; 265 m explored elevation span; 185+ SuperCam bedrock targets; CaSO4 + fluorite veins about 25 cm, eastern Margin Unit only; 3 water events (ages not determined).
science_purpose: Sample carbonate-rich shoreline rocks that record past water chemistry
chemistry: Carbonate 6-16 wt%; PIXL MgO 21±10 wt% (E) / 26±12 wt% (W) [V4][V5]

name: Delta Front
description: Western delta front; fan top above the crater floor; rim wall 610 m above the delta base; carbonate 3-9 wt% (Upper Fan).
science_purpose: Study layered delta sediments for evidence of standing water and preserved organics
chemistry: Carbonate 3-9 wt% (Upper Fan); Fe/Mg clay in delta sediments [V5]

name: Séítah
description: Séítah formation, crater floor; olivine CIPW 41.1 wt%, MgO 21.4 wt%, Mg# 62.8; olivine Fo54-72, grain 1.5 mm; domes up to 17 m above Máaz; traverse variation about 13 m.
science_purpose: Sample olivine-rich cumulate rock to read the crater floor volcanic history
chemistry: MgO 21.4 wt%; olivine 41.1 wt% (CIPW); Fo54-72; Mg# 62.8; carbonate <5 wt% (likely) [V2][V5]

name: Kodiak
description: Kodiak, isolated delta remnant; representative elevation -2,510 m (centre sample -2,527 m; the butte rises to about -2,483 m about 1.2 km west); about 2.2 km from the rover in PIA24814.
science_purpose: Read delta stratigraphy in an isolated remnant that the river left behind

name: Western Delta
goal: Delta deposits at the Neretva mouth
description: Western delta at the mouth of Neretva Vallis; layered delta sediments; carbonate 3-9 wt% (Upper Fan).
science_purpose: Sample delta-front layers where the ancient river met the lake
chemistry: Carbonate 3-9 wt% (Upper Fan); Fe/Mg clay in delta sediments [V5]

name: Belva Crater
description: Belva Crater, 0.90 km diameter, elevation -2,489 m (MEASURED, CTX DTM); IAU Feature 15872, adopted 2020-01-17.
geology: Impact crater superposed on delta deposits (Z2 edge)
science_purpose: Reference landmark and elevation anchor on the delta; crater-counting context
chemistry: No published chemistry for Belva in sources used

name: Cheyava Falls
description: Cheyava Falls rock, 1.0 x 0.6 m, sol 1212 (2024-07-18), WATSON; CaSO4 veins run its length; vivianite + greigite leopard spots (mm-scale); organic carbon + phosphorus; Sapphire Canyon core sol 1215, 6.2 cm, 22nd rock sample - POTENTIAL BIOSIGNATURE ONLY, not confirmed life (Nature-validated Sept 2025). Location not published: placed by zone (Z4 Neretva Vallis / Bright Angel) + sol, never by invented coordinates.
science_purpose: Sample a rock with leopard-spot textures and organic molecules; test for a potential biosignature
chemistry: Organic carbon + phosphorus; vivianite + greigite leopard spots; CaSO4 veins; SHERLOC detected organics [R12][R19][V7]

name: Bright Angel
description: Bright Angel, light-toned exposure at the base of the northern wall of Neretva Vallis; northern exposure 1.2+ km long; imaged sol 1172 (2024-06-06, Navcam PIA26336) and sol 1178 panorama (Mastcam-Z PIA26369, 346 images). Location not published: placed by zone (Z4) + sol, never by invented coordinates.
science_purpose: Characterise light-toned outcrops that may be ancient channel-fill sediment; SHERLOC organic-molecule spectra (4 targets)
chemistry: SHERLOC: organic molecules (G-band Raman) in 4 targets - Apollo Temple, Cheyava Falls, Walhalla Glades, Malgosa Crest [R21]; carbonate not published for this zone

name: Broom Point
description: Broom Point, outer rim; stack of 6 rock types, 75 m thick, strata tilted 80+ degrees; rock older than 3.9 billion years; Silver Mountain, Green Gardens (serpentinite) and Main River cores from the rim. Location not published: placed by zone (Z5 rim) + traverse, never by invented coordinates.
science_purpose: Read the oldest rocks Perseverance has examined: repeated impact stratigraphy from early Mars
chemistry: Igneous / impactite; no published carbonate for this zone
